codeReview.summary: The fix commit correctly addresses two prior failures (TripMap first-load full-trip fit and ElevationChart axis labels/zero-range guard), but RouteAnimation reset logic is still incorrect for the required play semantics because pause/resume on the same activity now restarts from distance 0.

issues.description: `currentDistance` is reset on every `path` prop identity change (`useEffect(..., [path])`). In `TripMap`, `animationPath` is recomputed from `streams.latlng.map(...)` whenever `animationState` changes (`src/components/Map/TripMap.tsx:26-31`), so toggling Play/Pause or speed recreates `path` and forces a reset to 0. This breaks the required behavior that only non-paused restarts (completion/route change) should start from the beginning; paused mid-run should resume from the paused position.
